description: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines - Rooftop Solar Potential Mapping is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Anh Nguyet, Daron Bedrosyan, Yi Xiong (NEO). This dataset contains solar rooftop potential data (suitable rooftop area, installable capacity, estimated yearly electricity generation, and building type ) at individual building structure level for a sample area of interest in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. Coverage: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. It has 4 files in ZIP, CSV, XLS, Other. The portal files it under Energy efficiency, Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
